valid.rationale: History shows setup slack is the primary bottleneck (worst path touches I/O ports). 'DELAY' synthesis strategies (DELAY 3/4) consistently yield better setup margins than 'AREA' strategies. 'RUN_POST_GRT_DESIGN_REPAIR' is critical for fixing I/O port violations seen in multiple runs. 'PL_ROUTABILITY_DRIVEN' helps reduce wirelength and congestion, improving timing. 'FP_CORE_UTIL' at 27% offers a good balance between density and repairability. Pin these knobs to replicate successful patterns while letting the optimizer tune others.
